title.narrative: Second Road Network Development Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: Project 1 will fund two components: i) Infrastructure Development Component - construction of an approximately 30 km section of the new motorway between Masalli and Jalilabad of the Masalli-Shorsulu road; rehabilitation of the R32 Ujar-Zardab-Agjabedi road, and ii) Project Implementation Support Components - project implementation support to ARS for construction supervision and program management covering planning, procurement, project preparation and implementation.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Efficient, adequate, safe, and sustainable road corridors in Azerbaijan achieved.

By 2022: Freight traffic increased by 12% (Baseline: 11,325 million ton-km in 2010). Achievement: 17531 Progress/Status: Target annual value achieved for 2020. Data Source: Project progress, completion reports of AAY, AAY annual surveys, Statistical Yearbook of Azerbaijan

By 2022: Passenger traffic increased by 7% (Baseline: 16,633 million passenger-km in 2010). Achievement: 25950 Progress/Status: Target annual value achieved for 2020. Data Source: Project progress, completion reports of AAY, AAY annual surveys, Statistical Yearbook of Azerbaijan

By 2022: Funding for road maintenance increased to at least $250 million (Baseline: $200 million in 2011). Achievement: 189 Progress/Status: To be determined at completion. By 2021: Funding for road maintenance increased to at least AZN150 million (Baseline: AZN117 million in 2011) [for conversion the exchange rate of AZN1.7 per $ is used, as it is more economically reasonable than the largely artificial rate of AZN0.87 per $ before the devaluation]. Data Source: Road subsector budget and expenditure records of AAY

By 2022: Number of road traffic accidents reduced by 5% (Baseline: 2,890 number of accidents in 2011). Achievement: 1870 Progress/Status: Target annual value achieved for 2020. Data Source: Project progress, completion reports of AAY, AAY annual surveys, Statistical Yearbook of Azerbaijan

By 2022: About 1.2 million beneficiaries. Achievement: N Progress/Status: To be determined at completion. The population of the rural and urban centers, which directly benefit from the project roads. As per the data from the State Statistics Committee, total number of direct beneficiaries as of 2018 comprises 727,500 residents of the 5 administrative districts (rayons) located in the project areas: Masalli, Jalilabad, Ujar, Zardab, Agjabedi. Data Source: Project progress, completion reports of AAY, AAY annual surveys, Statistical Yearbook of Azerbaijan Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: A new motorway between Masalli and Jalilabad constructed and key sections of R32 rehabilitated. Indicator: By 2020: 30 km of new motorway Masalli-Jalilabad constructed with international roughness index of less than 5 meters per km (2010 baseline: 0) Achievement: 30 Progress/Status: Contract signed on 11 Dec 2013. Works commenced on 5 March 2014. Adjustment to contract price was endorsed on 8 August 2016. The revised contract completion date is 30 June 2017.
Civil works 100% completed, taking over certificate issued on 18 Aug 2017. Data Source: MFF and project progress, completion reports of AAY and AAY annual surveys

Output: Support to AAY on program management, supervision and implementation provided. Indicator: All contracts awarded and mobilized as planned before 2019. Achievement: 7 Progress/Status: All civil works and consulting services contracts under the project have been awarded. The works for Masalli-Jalilabad motorway section successfully completed, the two road works contracts for R32 road are under implementation. Construction supervision and program management consultants continues to provide services to support the PIU/ARS. Data Source: MFF and project progress, completion reports of AAY

Output: A new motorway between Masalli and Jalilabad constructed and key sections of R32 rehabilitated. Indicator: By 2021: 70 km of R32 rehabilitated with international roughness index of less than 5 meters per km (2017 baseline: IRI = >5) Achievement: 32.5 Progress/Status: Contracts for R32 signed on 31 Oct 2018. Implementation is on schedule: (i) Lot 1 contract implementation progress is 95%; Lot 2 contract's progress is 92% (as of 30 September 2020). Data Source: MFF and project progress, completion reports of AAY and AAY annual surveys

Output: Support to AAY on program management, supervision and implementation provided. Indicator: Report deliverables (monthly progress, safeguards, audit reports) timely completed and submitted as planned (2012 baseline: none) Achievement: 17 Progress/Status: Required report preparation and submission are attended to during project implementation. Data Source: MFF and project progress, completion reports of AAY

Output: Due diligence requirements for new road sections R32 and M5/R57 completed. Indicator: All needed due diligence documents approved by AAY by December 2017. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Consulting service to deliver due diligence requirements for 2 new road sections completed in Q1 2018. Data Source: AAY project progress reports Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y Actual value: Y
